properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. @ajs, 2026-10-21: "Keep A and B as ideas", after asking whether https://arxiv.org/html/2609.40169v1 ("Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution"; read through a summarizer, main text only) could make reflow2 a better DESIGN TOOL for its users. This is idea B of that answer.

THE PAPER keeps a candidate only when the lower end of a paired bootstrap interval of its gain over the current one is above zero (L_α > 0), never on the point estimate: a gain inside the noise is not kept.

FOR ANY USER'S DESIGN: a Decision whose stated reason is a measured comparison between options (a trade study, an A/B run, two prototypes measured) carries that comparison as a kept record: the paired measurements or their summary, the interval or test, α. reflow2 reads the REASON, not the choice: `supported` when the difference's lower bound clears zero at α (the 0.90.0 hypothesis-test reading), `within the noise` when it does not, `conditional` while no record is attached. flo2-calc computes the interval or test as a kept record (req:a-computed-fact-counts-only-through-its-kept-record).

BOUNDARY WITH SETTLED INTENT: dec:alternatives-unranked-forkable (accepted) says alternatives are unranked and the human judges, not a stored score. This idea ranks nothing and chooses nothing: the owner still chooses, possibly for reasons other than the measurement. It reads only whether the measured reason the owner GAVE holds up. If @ajs reads it as reopening that decision, it is his call.

ARENA (by @ajs's line of 2026-10-17): reflow2 records the comparison's record and computes the reading; calc computes the statistics; the agent runs the measurements; the owner decides.

CHEAP / EXPENSIVE: medium. A link from a Decision to the comparison record, a reading beside the owner's acceptance (as a chain's verdict already sits beside it), reusing phase 5's test machinery.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS: (i) many real choices rest on one measurement each, where no interval exists; those read `conditional`, which must not read as a fault. (ii) Statistics can be gamed by choosing α after the data; phase 5's criteria lock already answers that and must apply here.

OPTIONS, none chosen: (a) a Decision's reason linked to a hypothesis-test Verification, read with the existing verdicts; (b) a dedicated comparison record (paired, two options, α) with its own reading; (c) a skill step only (the decision-making skills ask for the interval), no new reading.
properties.name: OPEN — when a decision cites a measured comparison as its reason ("B measured better than A"), should reflow2 read whether that difference holds up statistically, so the reason reads supported or within the noise?
